summary: Master Public Policy Analysis and Formulation to design evidence-based policies and drive measurable results. Enroll in our 5-day intermediate course today.
lede: Policy analysis helps public-sector professionals diagnose policy problems and assess options before implementation. Designed for professionals involved in policy design, delivery, and evaluation, the course covers systems thinking and root-cause analysis, cost-benefit and cost-effectiveness methods, implementation planning around political and institutional constraints, and impact evaluation using causal inference; learners also practice turning findings into clear policy briefs.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for senior and mid-level professionals who lead policy design, implementation, and evaluation in public administration, international development, and regulatory bodies.
audience: Strategic Planners in public sector agencies
modules: Foundations of Public Policy and the Policy Cycle
Diagnosing Policy Problems and Setting the Agenda
Policy Analysis Approaches and Cost-Benefit Evaluation
Designing Policy Frameworks and Implementation Strategies
Impact Evaluation and Causal Inference Methods
Stakeholder Engagement and Inclusive Policy Development
Predictive Analytics and AI in Policy Diagnostics
Policy Briefs, Reporting, and Strategic Roadmaps
prerequisites: Participants should have a working knowledge of organizational policy frameworks, strategic planning principles, and basic data analysis concepts. A background in public administration, economics, or social sciences is recommended. No coding skills are required, but familiarity with Excel or basic statistical tools is beneficial.
